### GT save function

```{r portal-plot, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(cbbplotR)
library(rlang)

# save function 
gt_save_crop <- function(data, file = NULL, bg = "white", whitespace = 50, zoom = 2, expand = 5) {
  tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".png")
  
  # Wrap the gtsave_extra call in a tryCatch to handle errors
  tryCatch({
    gtExtras::gtsave_extra(data, tmp, zoom = zoom, expand = expand)
  }, error = function(e) {
    # If there's an error, try using regular gt::gtsave instead
    message("gtsave_extra failed, trying gt::gtsave...")
    gt::gtsave(data, tmp, zoom = zoom, expand = expand)
  })
  
  magick::image_read(tmp) |> 
    magick::image_trim() |> 
    magick::image_border(bg, glue::glue('{whitespace}x{whitespace}')) |> 
    magick::image_write(file)
  unlink(tmp)
}
```

### Differentials

```{r diffs, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

season       <- 2026
date_cutoff  <- "2026-05-27"
caption_note = "data via WarrenNolan.com | Table by Chris at Bless your chart"

# Standard Sage Green Theme
color_positive     <- "#EAEFEA"  
color_dominant     <- "#A1C9A8"  
color_negative     <- "#FFE7E7"  
color_dominant_neg <- "#FF9999"  
color_zero         <- "#F5F5F5"  

bracket_teams <- tibble::tribble(
  ~team_name,       ~espn_id, ~side,
  "Troy",           2653,    "Side 1",
  "West Virginia",  277,     "Side 1",
  "North Carolina", 153,     "Side 1",
  "Ole Miss",       145,     "Side 1",
  "Oklahoma",       201,     "Side 2",
  "Alabama",        333,     "Side 2",
  "Texas",          251,     "Side 2",
  "Georgia",        61,      "Side 2"
)

scrape_team_schedule <- function(team_name, season) {
  url_slug <- stringr::str_replace_all(team_name, " ", "-")
  url      <- paste0("https://www.warrennolan.com/baseball/", season, "/schedule/", url_slug)
  page     <- rvest::read_html(url)
  
  game_blocks <- page |> rvest::html_elements("li.team-schedule")
  
  parse_game <- function(block, game_id) {
    month <- block |> rvest::html_element(".team-schedule__game-date--month") |> rvest::html_text(trim = TRUE)
    day   <- block |> rvest::html_element(".team-schedule__game-date--day")   |> rvest::html_text(trim = TRUE)
    date  <- as.Date(paste0(month, " ", day, " ", season), format = "%b %d %Y")
    
    loc_text      <- block |> rvest::html_element(".team-schedule__location") |> rvest::html_text(trim = TRUE)
    game_location <- dplyr::case_when(
      stringr::str_detect(loc_text, "AT") ~ "Away",
      stringr::str_detect(loc_text, "VS") ~ "Neutral",
      TRUE ~ "Home"
    )
    
    opponent <- block |> rvest::html_element(".team-schedule__opp-line-link") |> rvest::html_text(trim = TRUE)
    
    box_table <- block |> rvest::html_element("table.team-schedule-bottom__box-score")
    if (is.na(box_table)) return(NULL) 
    
    box_rows <- box_table |> rvest::html_elements("tr")
    if (length(box_rows) < 3) return(NULL)
    
    parse_row <- function(row) {
      team <- row |> rvest::html_elements("td") |> rvest::html_text(trim = TRUE) |> dplyr::first()
      team_clean <- stringr::str_trim(stringr::str_remove(team, "\\s*\\(\\d+\\)"))
      
      inning_vals <- row |> rvest::html_elements("td.team-schedule-bottom__box-score:not(.team-schedule-bottom__box-score--totals)") |> rvest::html_text(trim = TRUE)
      inning_vals <- inning_vals[-1]
      totals <- row |> rvest::html_elements("td.team-schedule-bottom__box-score--totals") |> rvest::html_text(trim = TRUE)
      list(team = team_clean, innings = inning_vals, totals = totals)
    }
    
    row2 <- parse_row(box_rows[[2]])
    row3 <- parse_row(box_rows[[3]])
    if (is.null(row2) || is.null(row3)) return(NULL)
    
    is_target_row2 <- (tolower(row2$team) == tolower(team_name))
    is_target_row3 <- (tolower(row3$team) == tolower(team_name))
    
    if (!is_target_row2 && !is_target_row3) return(NULL)
    
    target_row <- if (is_target_row2) row2 else row3
    opp_row    <- if (is_target_row2) row3 else row2
    
    team_total <- if (is_target_row2) {
      suppressWarnings(as.numeric(row2$totals[1]))
    } else {
      suppressWarnings(as.numeric(row3$totals[1]))
    }
    
    opp_total  <- if (is_target_row2) {
      suppressWarnings(as.numeric(row3$totals[1]))
    } else {
      suppressWarnings(as.numeric(row2$totals[1]))
    }
    
    if (is.na(team_total) || is.na(opp_total) || (team_total == 0 && opp_total == 0)) return(NULL)
    
    n_innings <- max(length(target_row$innings), length(opp_row$innings))
    if (n_innings == 0) return(NULL)
    
    innings_df <- purrr::map_dfr(seq_len(n_innings), function(i) {
      target_val <- if (i <= length(target_row$innings)) target_row$innings[i] else NA_character_
      opp_val    <- if (i <= length(opp_row$innings))    opp_row$innings[i]    else NA_character_
      
      clean <- function(v) {
        if (is.na(v) || v == "X" || v == "") NA_real_
        else suppressWarnings(as.numeric(v))
      }
      
      target_runs <- clean(target_val)
      opp_runs    <- clean(opp_val)
      both_na     <- is.na(target_runs) & is.na(opp_runs)
      
      tibble::tibble(
        inning      = i,
        team_runs   = target_runs,
        opp_runs    = opp_runs,
        inning_diff = dplyr::if_else(!both_na, dplyr::coalesce(target_runs, 0) - dplyr::coalesce(opp_runs, 0), NA_real_),
        score_inn   = dplyr::if_else(!both_na, paste0(dplyr::coalesce(target_val, "x"), "-", dplyr::coalesce(opp_val, "x")), NA_character_)
      )
    })
    
    innings_df |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        game_id = game_id, date = date, game_location = game_location, opponent = opponent,
        team_total = team_total, opp_total = opp_total,
        diff_total = team_total - opp_total, score_total = paste0(team_total, "-", opp_total)
      )
  }
  
  purrr::imap(as.list(game_blocks), \(block, idx) purrr::possibly(parse_game, NULL)(block, idx)) |>
    purrr::compact() |> dplyr::bind_rows()
}

build_innings_wide <- function(innings_long, date_cutoff, team_name, team_max_innings) {
  innings_long_filtered <- innings_long |> dplyr::filter(date >= as.Date(date_cutoff))
  if (nrow(innings_long_filtered) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  innings_wide_filtered <- innings_long_filtered |>
    dplyr::select(game_id, date, game_location, opponent, inning, inning_diff, team_runs, opp_runs, score_inn) |>
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = inning, values_from = c(inning_diff, team_runs, opp_runs, score_inn), names_sep = "_") |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      team_total  = rowSums(dplyr::across(dplyr::matches("^team_runs_\\d+$")), na.rm = TRUE),
      opp_total   = rowSums(dplyr::across(dplyr::matches("^opp_runs_\\d+$")),  na.rm = TRUE),
      diff_total  = team_total - opp_total,
      score_total = paste0(team_total, "-", opp_total),
      grp         = "TOURNAMENT GAMES"
    ) |>
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(date), dplyr::desc(game_id))
  
  totals_row <- innings_wide_filtered |>
    dplyr::summarise(dplyr::across(where(is.numeric), \(x) sum(x, na.rm = TRUE))) |>
    dplyr::mutate(opponent = "", date = as.Date(NA), game_location = "", grp = "TOTALS", diff_total = team_total - opp_total, score_total = paste0(team_total, "-", opp_total))
  
  for (i in seq_len(team_max_innings)) {
    t_col <- paste0("team_runs_", i); o_col <- paste0("opp_runs_", i); d_col <- paste0("inning_diff_", i); s_col <- paste0("score_inn_", i)
    if (t_col %in% names(totals_row)) {
      totals_row[[d_col]] <- totals_row[[t_col]] - totals_row[[o_col]]
      totals_row[[s_col]] <- paste0(totals_row[[t_col]], "-", totals_row[[o_col]])
    }
  }
  
  dplyr::bind_rows(totals_row, innings_wide_filtered) |> dplyr::mutate(row_order = dplyr::row_number())
}

build_individual_gt <- function(wide_data, team_name, espn_id, team_max_innings) {
  if (is.null(wide_data)) return(NULL)
  
  diff_cols   <- paste0("inning_diff_", seq_len(team_max_innings))
  score_cols  <- paste0("score_inn_",   seq_len(team_max_innings))
  
  present_diff_cols <- intersect(diff_cols, names(wide_data))
  
  dominant_cells <- purrr::map_dfr(seq_along(present_diff_cols), function(i) {
    d_col <- present_diff_cols[i]; t_col <- paste0("team_runs_", i); o_col <- paste0("opp_runs_", i)
    wide_data |> dplyr::mutate(row_num = dplyr::row_number()) |>
      dplyr::filter(row_num != 1, !is.na(.data[[d_col]]), .data[[t_col]] >= 2, .data[[o_col]] == 0) |>
      dplyr::select(row_num) |> dplyr::mutate(diff_col = d_col)
  })
  
  dominant_cells_neg <- purrr::map_dfr(seq_along(present_diff_cols), function(i) {
    d_col <- present_diff_cols[i]; t_col <- paste0("team_runs_", i); o_col <- paste0("opp_runs_", i)
    wide_data |> dplyr::mutate(row_num = dplyr::row_number()) |>
      dplyr::filter(row_num != 1, !is.na(.data[[d_col]]), .data[[o_col]] >= 2, .data[[t_col]] == 0) |>
      dplyr::select(row_num) |> dplyr::mutate(diff_col = d_col)
  })
  
  header_html <- glue::glue(
  "<link href='https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Roboto+Condensed:wght@700&display=swap' rel='stylesheet'>
   <div style='display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 4px;'>
     <div style=\"font-weight: bold; font-family: 'Roboto Condensed', sans-serif; font-size: 16px; color: #111;\">{toupper(team_name)}</div>
     <div><img src='https://a.espncdn.com/combiner/i?img=/i/teamlogos/ncaa/500/{espn_id}.png' style='height: 28px;'></div>
   </div>"
)
  
  tbl <- wide_data |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      game_desc = dplyr::if_else(is.na(date), "", paste0(game_location, " | ", format(as.Date(date), "%b %d"))),
      opponent  = stringr::str_trim(stringr::str_remove(opponent, "\\s*\\(\\d+\\)"))
    ) |>
    gt::gt(groupname_col = "grp") |>
    gtUtils::gt_theme_savant() |>
    gt::tab_options(row_group.as_column = FALSE, row_group.padding = gt::px(4), table.font.size = gt::px(11)) |>
    gt::cols_width(opponent ~ gt::px(140)) |>
    gt::data_color(
      columns = dplyr::all_of(c(present_diff_cols, "diff_total")),
      colors = scales::col_bin(bins = c(-Inf, -0.5, 0.5, Inf), palette = c(color_negative, color_zero, color_positive)),
      na_color = "#FFFFFF"
    ) |>
    gt::fmt(
      columns = dplyr::all_of(c(present_diff_cols, "diff_total")),
      fns = function(x) {
        dplyr::case_when(
          is.na(x) ~ NA_character_,
          x > 0    ~ paste0("+", x),
          TRUE     ~ as.character(x)
        )
      }
    ) |>
    gtExtras::gt_merge_stack(col1 = opponent, col2 = game_desc, palette = c("black", "#333333"), small_cap = FALSE) |>
    gtExtras::gt_merge_stack(col1 = diff_total, col2 = score_total, palette = c("black", "#333333"), small_cap = FALSE)
  
  for (i in seq_along(present_diff_cols)) {
    tbl <- tbl |> gtExtras::gt_merge_stack(col1 = !!rlang::sym(present_diff_cols[i]), col2 = !!rlang::sym(paste0("score_inn_", i)), palette = c("black", "#333333"), small_cap = FALSE)
  }
  
  if (nrow(dominant_cells) > 0) {
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(dominant_cells))) {
      tbl <- tbl |> gt::tab_style(style = gt::cell_fill(color = color_dominant), locations = gt::cells_body(columns = dominant_cells$diff_col[i], rows = dominant_cells$row_num[i]))
    }
  }
  if (nrow(dominant_cells_neg) > 0) {
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(dominant_cells_neg))) {
      tbl <- tbl |> gt::tab_style(style = gt::cell_fill(color = color_dominant_neg), locations = gt::cells_body(columns = dominant_cells_neg$diff_col[i], rows = dominant_cells_neg$row_num[i]))
    }
  }
  
  tbl |>
    gt::cols_label(opponent = "", diff_total = "TOTAL") |>
    gt::cols_label(.list = setNames(as.list(as.character(seq_along(present_diff_cols))), present_diff_cols)) |>
    gt::tab_spanner(label = "Innings", columns = dplyr::all_of(present_diff_cols)) |>
    gt::text_transform(
      locations = gt::cells_body(columns = dplyr::all_of(present_diff_cols)),
      fn = function(x) {
        dplyr::case_when(
          is.na(x) | x == "" | stringr::str_detect(x, ">NA<|NA-NA") ~ 
            "<div style='line-height: 1.2;'><div style='font-weight: bold; color: black;'>—</div><div style='color: #555555; font-size: 0.9em;'>—</div></div>",
          TRUE ~ x
        )
      }
    ) |>
    gt::tab_header(title = gt::html(header_html)) |>
    gt::cols_hide(c(dplyr::matches("^score_inn_\\d+$"), dplyr::matches("^team_runs_\\d+$"), dplyr::matches("^opp_runs_\\d+$"), team_total, opp_total, date, game_location, game_id, row_order)) |>
    gt::cols_move_to_start(columns = opponent)
}

all_tables <- purrr::map(seq_len(nrow(bracket_teams)), function(idx) {
  row  <- bracket_teams[idx, ]
  long <- scrape_team_schedule(row$team_name, season)
  
  team_max <- if (!is.null(long) && nrow(long) > 0) max(long$inning, na.rm = TRUE) else 9
  team_max <- max(team_max, 9)
  
  wide <- build_innings_wide(long, date_cutoff, row$team_name, team_max)
  build_individual_gt(wide, row$team_name, row$espn_id, team_max)
})

tmp_paths <- purrr::map_chr(seq_len(nrow(bracket_teams)), function(i) {
  p <- tempfile(fileext = ".png")
  gtUtils::gt_save_crop(all_tables[[i]], file = p, whitespace = 15, bg = "white")
  return(p)
})


create_stitched_panel <- function(indices, title_text, subtitle_text, output_filename) {
  plots <- purrr::map(indices, function(i) {
    img  <- png::readPNG(tmp_paths[i])
    grob <- grid::rasterGrob(img, interpolate = TRUE)
    patchwork::wrap_elements(grob)
  })
  
  grid_layout <- (plots[[1]] + plots[[2]]) / (plots[[3]] + plots[[4]])
  
  final_plot <- grid_layout + 
    patchwork::plot_annotation(
      title    = title_text,
      subtitle = subtitle_text,
      caption  = caption_note,
      theme    = ggplot2::theme(
        plot.title    = ggplot2::element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, family = "Roboto Condensed"),
        plot.subtitle = ggtext::element_markdown(size = 11, family = "Roboto Condensed", color = "#444444", hjust = 0.5, margin = ggplot2::margin(b = 10)),
        plot.caption  = ggplot2::element_text(size = 9, family = "Roboto Condensed", face = "bold", color = "#666666")
      )
    )
  
  ggplot2::ggsave(output_filename, plot = final_plot, width = 12, height = 9, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
}
```
